basis.governing_question: Why did prepaid churn rise in 2025 at Lusitania Telecom, and how can it be brought down?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why prepaid churn rose in 2025 across customer behavior, retention offers and store operations.

gate.label: Findings sign-off
gate.decision: Accept the causes found for the 2025 prepaid churn rise as the basis for design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the retention program for prepaid customers, with its offers, store actions and rollout plan.

gate.label: Program approval
gate.decision: Approve the retention program and its rollout plan?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the approved retention program with Lusitania Telecom's teams and measure early churn movement against the diagnostic baseline.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Accept the rollout results and the next steps for the retention program?

architect_notes: The 4, 3 and 6 week split of the stated 13 weeks is an estimate; rollout falls below the archetype's eight-week minimum.
Design was added to the performance improvement archetype because the brief asks how to bring churn down, not only why it rose.
Measurement after launch is not planned; churn results beyond the 13 weeks are not covered, so confirm whether tracking is expected.
